fixtures.case_note: Planted fixture keys (one repeated digit, one sequential run) are never real credentials. Path-sensitive runners must stage these outside test trees, where the testing-corpus suppressor would otherwise decide the case.
A random-body key in the same field shape retains the finding (same staging note applies).

purpose: Synthetic-key controls for the AWS access-key pattern: repeated-digit and sequential-run bodies are excluded, random bodies still fire.
